docLabel: code review (inline comments plus a summary)

judge.reader: Sam Okafor, the PR's author, a mid-level engineer who will act on each comment
questions: Can the author tell from each comment alone whether it blocks the merge?
Does the review open with the verdict, with the two security findings ahead of everything else?
Does it stay within the reviewer's notes, adding no findings of its own and overstating none?
Is the 30-day question asked as a question, and the naming point offered as optional?
